title: Studio Prompt
description:
A prompt template definition with text chunks and configurable variables.

Stability: future versions of this schema must remain backward-compatible with content authored against earlier versions of itself — once a package is published with a given version, it must continue to validate against the schema in force at install time. Add fields conservatively (optional first); promote to required only with a major schema revision and a migration story.

chunks.description: Ordered text chunks that are assembled into the final prompt.

variables.description: Configurable variables referenced by {{ name }} in chunk text.

text.description: Prompt text. May contain {{ variable_name }} template expressions.

variable.description: Variable name this chunk is associated with. Null for static text chunks.

order.description: Assembly order. Lower = earlier in the prompt.

role.description: Chat message role for this chunk.

name.description: Variable identifier. Must match {{ name }} references in chunks.

label.description: Human-readable label shown in the form.

type.description: Variable type. 'enum' renders as a dropdown, 'string' as a text field, 'number' as a number input.

options.description: Available option values for enum-type variables. Null for other types.

option_labels.description: Parallel human-readable labels for each entry in `options`. Mirrors the provider-schema `enumNames` convention — must be the same length as `options` when present. The form schema endpoint uses these to render the dropdown while the raw `options` value is what gets stored. Null for non-enum types or when the raw values are already user-friendly.

default.description: Default value. Used during assembly if no value provided.

required.description: When true, the form-schema endpoint surfaces this variable as a required form field AND Prompt.assemble() on the API raises if the value is empty. Use for load-bearing variables where the chunk must never drop. Defaults to false (optional — chunk drops silently when empty).
